market_context.summary: US small- and mid-cap valuations are below the large-cap market, while elevated Treasury yields make multiple expansion an unsuitable base-case assumption.
market_context.small_mid_cap_valuation_context: Small and mid caps trade at a discount to mega caps, but financing-sensitive businesses require a higher margin of safety.
sector_cycle_notes: Software demand is stable but selective.
Commercial biopharma requires product-concentration and LOE stress checks.
